maddeler.e:
اصطدموا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَدَمُوا (iṣṭadamū) /isˤ.tˤa.da.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اُصْطُدِمُوا (uṣṭudimū) /usˤ.tˤu.di.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اِصْطَدِمُوا (iṣṭadimū) /isˤ.tˤa.di.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
